reference: Your Majesty, Sector 47 was sealed off yesterday.

source: 현재 황도 주변에서도 급격한 지열 상승이 관측되고 있습니다.
reference: Rapid rises in geothermal heat are also being observed around the Imperial Capital.
I see... That is faster than the land surveyor predicted.
This place will not hold out much longer either.

source: 아르스의 수명이 다해 갈수록 그 혈액인 에테르류의 온도가 상승하니.
reference: As Ars's lifespan draws to an end, the temperature of the Ether flow, its blood, rises.

source: 국라로 천도하시려던 계획을 앞당기시는 게 어떨지요?
reference: How about bringing forward your plan to move the capital to Gukra?

source: 영사를 경질한 지 얼마 되지 않았습니다.
reference: It has not been long since we dismissed the consul.

source: 국라 주민들에게 한 설명도 충분치 못했지요.
reference: The explanation we gave the residents of Gukra was not sufficient either.

source: 괜한 반감을 사는 건 피하고 싶습니다만.
reference: I would like to avoid causing unnecessary resentment, though.
There is little time left for a reprieve.
It is not just us.
Even Gula, with its fertile land...
The grain harvest is decreasing every year.

source: 이 세계 전체가 비명을 지르고 있죠…
reference: The entire world is screaming...
Your Majesty? What is wrong?
No... I think it is just my imagination.
Sister... Where on earth are you...
The great hollow has almost disappeared.
The great hollow was created by the Serpent, after all.
So that is how it was.

source: 그 서펀트가 사라졌으니 대공동도 사라진 건가?
reference: Since the Serpent disappeared, did the great hollow disappear too?
It looks climbable, but...

source: 평범한 등산 수준이 아닐 것 같은데.
reference: I doubt this will be an ordinary hike, though.
Everyone, this way.
Homura?
I cannot believe the inside of the World Tree looks like this.

source: 인공적인 탑 주위에 거대한 식물이 엉켜 있는 것 같군요.
reference: It looks as though huge plants are tangled around the artificial tower.

source: 이걸 타면 위로 갈 수 있을 거예요.
reference: We should be able to go up if we ride this.

source: 위로? 근데 호무라, 방금 뭘 한 거야?
reference: Up? But Homura, what did you just do?
I do not really know either.

source: 제47구는 봉쇄됐지만 제48구는 아직 열려 있습니다.
reference: Sector 47 is sealed off, but Sector 48 is still open.
You may open the door.
You must not open the door.

source: 제가 왕자를 구했어요. 왕자가 저를 구한 게 아니에요.
reference: I saved the prince. The prince did not save me.

source: 한 명도 남기지 말고 모두 데려오세요.
reference: Bring everyone back without leaving a single person behind.

source: 독이 든 건 이 잔이 아니라 저 잔입니다.
reference: The poisoned cup is that one, not this one.
Homura handed the key to Mets.
He ran away as soon as he received it.
It is not over yet.
Yes, but not right now.
